rule: 这些句子在全本顺序阅读之后被考虑，并按手册排除。没有进口为可评分预测。引文是解码后原文的连续片段，保留 CRLF。每段短于 300 字符。
edition_limit: 题名页印 1908，只有年份。印次说明写 Commonweal 1890、波士顿 1890、修订英文版 1891。没有逐行核对，不声称这些句子已被证明首次发表于某一年。1890 至 1908 的事件不能单独核验这份文本。

refused.speaker: Dick
refused.quote:
"Oh, not very old," he said; "it was built or at least opened, in 2003.
There used to be a rather plain timber bridge before then."
refused.reason: 梦中的 Dick 给梦里的石桥一个年份。这不是作者对现实桥梁在 2003 年开通的可核预言。

refused.speaker: wall inscription
refused.quote:
the lecture-room of the Hammersmith Socialists_.  _Drink a glass to
   the memory_!  _May 1962_.
refused.reason: 客舍墙上的刻字把 1962 年 5 月写成已经过去的纪念。这是梦里的日期，不是作者预言 1962 年 5 月会发生这件事。

refused.speaker: Dick
refused.quote:
"a very jolly place, now that the
trees have had time to grow again since the great clearing of houses in
1955."
refused.reason: Dick 把 1955 年的大拆房屋说成树木已经重新长起来之前的事。年份在梦中人物口中，而且在故事里已经发生。

refused.speaker: Dick
refused.quote:
great battle which was fought on the spot itself in 1952,--that was
important enough, if the historians don't lie.
refused.reason: Dick 说 1952 年在这个地点打过仗，并说史家也许撒谎。这是梦中对已发生战斗的说法，不是作者对 1952 年真实战役的预言。

refused.speaker: Guest
refused.quote:
or have you come to a mere dictatorship, which some persons in
the nineteenth century used to prophesy as the ultimate outcome of
democracy?
refused.reason: 客人问十九世纪有人预言过的独裁是否已经到来。这是转述别人的旧预言并提出问题。Hammond 随后说他们没有政府。Morris 没有在这里主张独裁必将到来。

refused.speaker: Hammond
refused.quote:
there is a kind of fear growing up amongst us that we
shall one day be short of work.
refused.reason: Hammond 转述他们社会里正在增长的一种担心。同一章稍后他说自己并不认为会出现工作荒。担心本身不是作者对现实劳动供给的预言。

refused.speaker: Hammond
refused.quote:
are now and will be for a long while a great resource to
us.
refused.reason: Hammond 把梦中世界里曾经的美国说成现在以及还会很久都是他们的资源。对象是传奇里的北方美洲，不是作者对现实美国的可核预言。

refused.speaker: Hammond
refused.quote:
for nearly a hundred years the people of the northern parts of
America have been engaged in gradually making a dwelling-place out of a
stinking dust-heap
refused.reason: 他把北方美洲收拾垃圾堆说成已经进行了将近一百年。这是梦中历史的完成时，不是待核验的未来。

refused.speaker: Hammond
refused.quote: "It always was so, and I suppose always will be,"
refused.reason: Hammond 说艺术大概会一直偏爱陌生的过去。这是他对他们自己趣味的猜测，没有可核验的公共结果。

refused.speaker: Hammond
refused.quote:
the extinction of the
cholera, which has since happily taken place)
refused.reason: Hammond 用完成时把霍乱消失说成他们故事里已经发生的事，用来比喻商业的灭亡。不是作者对霍乱将在某年消失的预言。

refused.speaker: Hammond
refused.quote:
the prophecies of some of the reactionists of past times seemed as if
they would come true
refused.reason: Hammond 说反动派的旧预言一度好像要应验，接着写那片阴云只是威胁了一下就过去了。这是虚构往事，而且在故事里那些预言没有实现。

refused.speaker: Hammond
refused.quote:
So may it be
for ages and ages!
refused.reason: 这是祝愿，不是可核验的结果。

refused.speaker: Walter
refused.quote: this is not an age of inventions.
refused.reason: Walter 描述他们当时不用新发明。这是梦中现在的制度说法，不是作者预言现实世界将停止发明。

refused.speaker: Morsom
refused.quote:
"What is to come after this?"

The old man laughed.  "I don't know," said he; "we will meet it when it
comes."
refused.reason: 客人问起此后还有什么。Morsom 明确说不知道，来了再对付。作者在这里没有给出可核预言。

refused.speaker: Ellen
refused.quote:
Who knows?  Happy as we are, times may alter; we may be bitten
with some impulse towards change,
refused.reason: Ellen 用“谁知道”和“可能”担心时代会变。没有可核验的对象、方向终点或日期。这是人物的不确定忧虑，不进口为预测。

refused.speaker: Ellen
refused.quote:
if
your country is somewhat backward, it will come into line before long.
refused.reason: Ellen 对她以为来自另一处的客人说话。条件是那个被误认的国家落后。说话人、对象和“不久”都在传奇里，不是作者对某个实名国家的可核主张。

refused.speaker: narrator
refused.quote:
there is yet a time of
rest in store for the world, when mastery has changed into fellowship--but
not before.
refused.reason: 叙述者把这句话归于 Ellen 的神情，并在同一结尾说如果别人也能看见，这就可以叫做幻象而不是梦。书名页写明这是一部乌托邦传奇。这是收束的愿景，没有可核验的公共事件、对象或期限。

refused.speaker: Project Gutenberg license
refused.quote: Updated editions will replace the previous one
refused.reason: 这句在古腾堡结束标记之后，是许可证对电子文本更新的说明，不是 Morris 的话。

refused.speaker: Project Gutenberg license
refused.quote:
In 2001, the Project
Gutenberg Literary Archive Foundation was created
refused.reason: 2001 年成立文学档案基金会是许可证里对古腾堡自身的历史叙述。不能记成 Morris 的预言，也不能用来证明正文句子的首发年。
